description: gzapi.brand's rules for fabric-pr arm. The repository has no code and no build: it is the source of authority for the brand, and the other repositories copy its machine-read files at a pinned commit. boundary.paths: those files, which every consumer takes verbatim into its own build (brand/tokens.css, the design tokens, and brand/assets/fonts/, the vendored font files), the harness wiring (.claude/: settings and hooks), CI and package manifests should the repository ever grow them (.github/, package.json and lockfiles), and words where the boundary is a file anywhere (secret, credential, token, key, auth). boundary.exempt is dropped first, but never under .claude/: Markdown, which is the brand guide, the claims and the decision records' prose, and .agent-fabric/. No classes. waiver_role is null: only the owner waives the boundary.

direct.description: Direct to main: brand-comms commits the brand guide, claims, tokens, fonts and assets straight to main (the owner, 2026-10-10). By pull request: the harness wiring (.claude/, .mcp.json), CI, hooks, the package manifests and lockfiles, every script (anything under bin/, scripts/ or tools/, and shell, Python, Ruby, Perl, PowerShell, JavaScript and TypeScript files anywhere), config and tool-version files, Makefile/Dockerfile, .env* and .gitignore, any file whose git mode is executable, and secret-shaped names (secret, credential, api key, private key, password; an access, api, auth, refresh, bearer, bot, npm, gh, github or slack token; a service-account, private, gcp or google key.json; auth.json; anything under keys/; .pem/.p12/.p8/.pfx/.key/.jks/.keystore/.ppk). Styles, design tokens, fonts, images and content are direct.
